prompt: An image of a woman standing gracefully in an outdoor courtyard setting with a neutral beige wall and potted plants in the background. She is posed with one hand delicately holding a small, ornate potli bag, while the other hand gently holds the edge of her richly embroidered dupatta draped over her shoulder. She wears a luxurious traditional outfit consisting of a deep teal velvet anarkali dress adorned with intricate gold embroidery in floral and paisley patterns along the hem and bodice. The dress is paired with wide-legged maroon palazzo pants featuring elaborate gold motifs. Her maroon velvet dupatta is heavily embroidered with gold threadwork along the borders, adding a regal touch. The woman accessorizes with traditional jewelry including a large maang tikka on her forehead, matching earrings, and a statement necklace, all in gold with green and red accents. Her hair is neatly styled back, complementing the elegant and poised look. The overall ambiance is sophisticated and culturally rich, highlighting the opulence and detailed craftsmanship of the attire.
